carry_forward: the generator carries the last fixing forward over non-banking days
gaps_as_read: N/E on every Saturday and Sunday and on Wednesday 2026-09-16 (the CNBV closing day); nowhere else
note: The page also shows "Publicación DOF" (the next banking day) and "Para solventar obligaciones" (the rate applying to obligations that day); both are kept beside the fixing and are not used by the world.
query: form at https://www.banxico.org.mx/tipcamb/tipCamMIAction.do, fechaInicial 29/06/2026, fechaFinal 04/10/2026, series FIX, salida HTML, submitted in a browser on 2026-10-12 (the SIE REST API requires a registered token; the public query page does not)
series: Banco de México, tipo de cambio FIX (tipo de cambio para solventar obligaciones denominadas en dólares de los EE.UU.A., pagaderas en la República Mexicana), column "Determinación"
